title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 targets faster, lower-cost everyday work
friendlyTitle: Claude Sonnet 5.5 aims to do everyday work faster and for less
summary: Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5.5 across its apps, API and major cloud platforms. The company says it generates output more than 30% faster than Sonnet 5 and can cost up to 30% less per task at unchanged token prices because it typically uses fewer tokens.
friendlySummary: Anthropic says its new Sonnet model answers more than 30% faster and often uses fewer tokens to finish the same job. It is available in Claude, through the API and on major cloud services.
whyItMatters: For routine coding, document and spreadsheet work, lower task cost and latency may matter more than buying the strongest model available. Teams should test their own workloads, since Anthropic’s benchmark and cost figures come from launch evaluations and do not guarantee the same gains in production.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may make common AI tasks quicker and cheaper. Test it with your own real work before changing models, because published benchmark results may not match your workflow.
